item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 06/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of southern China in the next few days. It will be cool and windy over the region. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring unsettled weather to Guangdong over the weekend and early next week. A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Cool with a few rain patches in the morning and at night. Visibility relatively low at first.
Temp range: 16 - 20 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
